checked.claim: Reset the season inside Season setup does nothing: the press closes the window, the wait answers null and the null check returns before resetAsked is read.
checked.why: Read the order on b5a29e73 myself. drpgWindow returns foundry DialogV2.wait(config) (ui-kit.mjs:1344) with rejectClose: false, so a close made by dialog.close() answers null. The reset listener sets resetAsked and closes; the code after the wait tests endAsked, then returns on !result, and only then reads resetAsked, so the reset line is unreachable from the press. Looked for another road: resetSeason is called only at season-setup.mjs:1215 outside the tests (git grep in scripts/); api.mjs:814 opens Season setup, not the reset; gm-panel.mjs:305-309 says the tile is gone since A1d. The tests that name the line read it as text (tests-tier1.mjs:20694 a regular expression over the source; R4055 at :20336-20350 matches /data-drpg-reset-season/ and /resetSeason\(\)/), no test presses the button (git grep for drpg-reset-season finds only season-setup.mjs and R4055's querySelector on drawn HTML). lang/en.json:3341 sends the GM to this button at a season's last chapter. Major holds: the one door to an action a GM needs once a season is dead and says nothing.
checked.evidence: scripts/season-setup.mjs:1200-1203 'dialog.element.querySelector("[data-drpg-reset-season]")?.addEventListener("click", ev => { ev.preventDefault(); resetAsked = true; dialog.close();'; :1210 'rejectClose: false'; :1213-1215 'if (endAsked) return endTheChapter(...); if (!result || result === "close") return null; if (resetAsked) return (await import("./season-wipe.mjs")).resetSeason();'; scripts/ui-kit.mjs:1344 'return DialogV2.wait(config);'
